summary: Tested collapsible grouped navigation for Creator Portal and Admin Dashboard sidebars. Fixed critical React hooks order bug in AdminDashboard.jsx that was preventing the dashboard from rendering. All tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: React hooks order violation in AdminDashboard.jsx - useState was called conditionally after early return, causing 'React Hook useState is called conditionally' error
context_for_next_testing_agent: Collapsible grouped navigation is working correctly. Admin Dashboard has 6 groups (Overview, Operations, Finance, Engagement, Business, Super Admin). Creator Portal has 4 groups (Overview, Revenue, Content Tools, Growth). Groups expand/collapse on click with chevron icons toggling between right and down.

bug_fixed.issue: React Hook useState called conditionally - hooks were defined after early return 'if (loading)'
bug_fixed.fix: Moved NAV_GROUPS definition and useState(getInitialExpanded) BEFORE the early return statement
bug_fixed.impact: Admin Dashboard was crashing/not rendering due to hooks order violation

test_flow: Verify all 6 collapsible groups present in sidebar
Click Operations group - verify Users tab appears/disappears
Verify all 4 collapsible groups present in sidebar
Click Revenue group - verify Earnings tab appears/disappears
